text:
By County Herald Weather Center ,
8 hours ago Country Herald is Local News, Independent Pulse. Covering breaking local news, sports, lifestyle and events. MADISON, Wis. – A Frost Advisory is in effect for much of southern Wisconsin through 9 a.m. Thursday as overnight lows dip to near freezing. Residents from Dane to Lafayette counties are being urged to protect plants and sensitive vegetation ahead of the coldest night of the week.
